A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the results of DAMA/Na I and DAMA/LIB R A are in line with the expectations for the presence of DM in the galactic system, and they are not compatible with the hypothesis that the annual modulation signal is due to seasonal variations of the environmental background.
, over more than two decades, we have provided a model independent evidence for a DM component in the galactic system.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the DAMA experiment is still the only one which has been able to detect Dark Matter particles, in agreement with many other experiments, and that the DAMA/LB experiment, which is the only one which can test the annual modulation signature, has been able to confirm and improve the former results.

the DAMA/Libra annual modulation result, obtained by the model-independent annual modulation signature, is a robust and unique result, which has been confirmed and improved in more than one decade, by a single and single and single set-up, and by a single and unique technique.
